text:
Type: gingham upholstered swivel desk chair
Use: working at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, classic, Scandinavian
Materials: woven fabric upholstery in a small gingham check, button tufting, piped edges, dark grey steel five-star base, casters
Colors: grey and white check, dark grey
Shape: tall rounded rectangular back with four tufted buttons, wide padded seat with a piped edge, armless, slim column on a five-star base with casters, medium visual weight
Feel: homey, charming, soft, relaxed
Goes with: white or painted wood desks, grey and linen tones, country accents; farmhouse, cottage or Scandinavian home offices

product.name: LILLHJDEN
product.description: You sit comfortably since the chair is adjustable in height.
